register_of_information_fields.function_supported: Payment processing and client account management

compliance_gaps.description: Provider's Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is not documented in the contract.
Contract does not specify the locations (regions/countries) where data is processed and stored.
Missing provisions on availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of data.
No provisions on data access, recovery and return in the event of provider insolvency.
No provision requiring the provider to notify the entity in advance of data location changes.
Subcontracting is permitted but conditions and limitations are not specified.
